question:
Translate the following paragraph into Urdu:
Digital globalisation makes information from around the world instantly accessible. Students can learn about different cultures and traditions through websites, videos, and online articles, which broadens their understanding and promotes cultural awareness. Social media platforms allow people from different cultures to interact and share their daily lives. Such interaction allows people to recognise both similarities and differences among cultures.
